description: This file defines the AwsCredentials class in the AWS CRT Auth namespace, representing AWS credential objects with handling for access key ID, secret access key, session token, and expiration. It includes methods for constructing credentials with options and resource management.

classes.name: AwsCredentials
classes.description: Represents a set of AWS credentials including access key, secret key, session token, and expiration, with resource management functionalities.

methods.name: defaults
methods.description: Returns default values for AWS credentials options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AwsCredentials object with provided options, initializing internal state and resource handles.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Releases associated credentials resources upon object destruction.
